text.trigger: A player searches at the Gas Station.
text.vignette: A garage door at the back of the gas station finally gives to the right key. A snowmobile waits in the dark under a skin of dust, with a half-full jerrycan beside it.

options.take-the-snowmobile: Ride it: this card goes on the searching survivor, who never rolls exposure when moving but leaves a noise token at both ends of each move (a zombie at the colony instead of noise). Each move puts a wound on the snowmobile; at 4 it is removed from the game.
options.siphon-the-tank: Siphon it: search the Gas Station deck for 2 Fuel cards and add them to your hand.
